theater: 西西里西北部恩泰拉與山區

battle.name: 西西里叛亂
battle.theater: 西西里西北部恩泰拉與山區
battle.brief: 公元前44年，凱撒遇刺後局勢崩解之際，西西里島西部奴隸在恩泰拉舉事，阿耳忒彌多洛斯與特洛伊洛斯自稱「宣告者」，殺死元老院使者，席捲墨西拿與森圖里佩，到前43年被安東尼平定。卡面的斯巴達長矛屬公元前800年前的希臘方陣兵器，指向島上希臘城市民兵手中長矛的源頭。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 這場叛亂發生在公元前44年的西西里島，也就是羅馬共和國最老的一個行省。交戰的一方是羅馬：元老院與執政官掌握著島上的行省當局，總督駐帕諾爾莫斯，島上的羅馬軍團與公民城市是鎮壓的骨幹，羅馬公民的私產與稅收網絡遍布全島，莊園主、稅吏與奴隸主構成本地秩序的骨架；元老院、三頭同盟與事後執行的執政官級命令共同構成了羅馬一方的指揮系統，先後有數名將領被派往島上。另一方是起義者：主體是西西里莊園、礦場與城市作坊裡的奴隸隊伍，成分包括希臘人、敘利亞人、迦太基裔與本島土著，另有逃奴與被釋放的角鬥士；阿庇安記載說，東部的希臘化城市如陶羅梅尼翁與列昂提尼的公民也加入起義或接納叛軍，島上部分自由民以供應糧食、提供情報與引路的方式站在起義者一邊。西部與西南部的帕諾爾莫斯、利利拜、卡塔基等城市，以及沿海的拉丁殖民城市，始終效忠羅馬。整場衝突沒有第三國介入，本質是行省內部的武裝叛亂與鎮壓；但它發生在羅馬本土內戰最激烈的時刻，島上每一次調兵都直接牽動意大利的權力平衡。
countriesEn: This revolt took place in 44 BC in Sicily, the oldest province of the Roman Republic. One side was Rome: the senate and the consuls held the provincial administration of the island, the governor's seat being at Panormus; the Roman legions on the island and the citizen cities were the backbone of the suppression, and a web of Roman citizen property and taxation covered the whole island, the great landowners, tax collectors and slave owners forming the skeleton of local order. The senate, the Second Triumvirate and the consular orders issued afterwards together made up the Roman command system, and several commanders in turn were sent to the island. The other side were the insurgents: above all the slave gangs of the Sicilian estates, mines and city workshops, a mixed body of Greeks, Syrians, people of Carthaginian descent and Sicilian natives, together with runaway slaves and freed gladiators. Appian records that citizens of the Hellenic cities of the east, such as Tauromenium and Leontini, also joined the rising or admitted the rebels, while some free inhabitants of the island supported the insurgents by supplying grain, providing intelligence and showing the way. The western and south-western cities of Panormus, Lilybaeum and Catagella, along with the Latin colonial towns on the coast, remained loyal to Rome throughout. No third country intervened: at bottom this was an armed rebellion and its suppression inside a province. But it happened at the moment of the most violent civil war in Roman history, and every column Rome moved on the island was tied directly to the balance of power in Italy.
people: 起義方面的核心人物只有兩位，都是羅馬世界裡相當特殊的人物。阿耳忒彌多洛斯來自阿利恰，是阿耳忒彌斯女神的聖侍之一，人稱阿孔提亞諾斯；他出身不低卻淪為奴隸，靠口才與這層神聖身分取得眾人的追隨。特洛伊洛斯是奇里西亞人，早年做過角鬥士並管理過角鬥學校，熟悉格鬥、武器與隊形管理，這正是義軍裡最稀缺的本錢。兩人自稱宣告者（克琉泰），說明島上奴隸的解放是某種更高意志的安排，並以神諭、旗幟與宣言維持隊伍的士氣；在阿庇安的敘述裡，叛軍的紀律與宣傳能力遠高於一般烏合之眾。羅馬方面的指揮更替頻繁：前44年元老院把戰線交給屋大維，但屋大維被意大利的兵源問題與對手牽制，前線先後由馬爾凱羅斯、多米提烏斯·阿赫諾巴布斯等人接手，馬爾凱羅斯在前45年於米利切被自己部下的士兵刺殺，顯示義軍的滲透與暗殺手段已經觸及羅馬的指揮層。最後由前43年的執政官馬克·安東尼接手，他集結主力，直接攻取恩泰拉與托爾托拉兩處山寨，結束了戰事。
peopleEn: The rising had only two leaders of its own, and both were unusual figures in the Roman world. Artemidorus came from Aricia and was one of the sacred attendants of Artemis, an Acontian; he was not of low birth but had been enslaved, and it was his eloquence and that priestly standing that won him followers. Troilus was a Cilician who had been a gladiator and had managed a gladiator school, so he knew fighting, weapons and the handling of formations, which was precisely the scarcest asset in the rebel ranks. The two of them styled themselves heralds (kleutai), declaring that the freeing of the Sicilian slaves was the work of some higher will, and they kept the rank and file in line with oracles, banners and proclamations; in Appian's account the discipline and the propaganda of the rebels were far above what a mere rabble manages. On the Roman side the command changed hands repeatedly. In 44 BC the senate handed the front to Octavian, but Octavian was held up in Italy by the problem of manning the army and by his rivals, and the line was in turn taken by Marcellus and by men such as Gnaeus Domitius Ahenobarbus; Marcellus was murdered by one of his own soldiers at Melite in 45 BC, which shows that infiltration and assassination by the insurgents had already reached the Roman command level. The campaign was finally taken over in 43 BC by the consul Mark Antony, who concentrated the main force, took the two strongholds of Entella and Tortora, and ended the war.
kits: 卡面兵器是斯巴達長矛（Dory）：約兩米長的直木杆，前端裝葉形矛頭，杆尾套一截銅套，插地時可以讓戰士跪在盾牌後方掩蔽；這是公元前800年前後斯巴達與希臘城邦方陣的標準長矛，比這場戰爭早八百多年，到公元前44年早已不是任何一支軍隊的制式兵器，當時歐洲戰場上通行的長杆武器是馬其頓式的薩里沙與羅馬的標槍。把它放進這場戰爭，是要標出長矛這條技術譜系在希臘世界的源頭：西西里島東部的墨西拿、陶羅梅尼翁、列昂提尼都是古老的希臘城邦，城市民兵至今仍按傳統配備長矛、小圓盾、青銅頭盔與青銅護胸，其中長矛的做法正是從卡面這種樣式一路傳下來的；而在尼布羅迪山脈、馬多尼耶山一帶放牧、狩獵與伐炭的奴隸和農人，手裡的長獵矛、削尖的橡木幹與農用長柄工具，構成了同一譜系在鄉村的殘存形貌。義軍的裝備因此是混編的：劫掠莊園與城內武器庫所得的羅馬式短劍、銅盔與環鏈甲碎片，角鬥士用的重盾與面網，希臘式小圓盾與青銅護胸，投石索與石彈，以及大量臨時削製的長杆兵器。羅馬方面是全套制式軍備：重投槍 pilum 配橢圓大盾 scutum、輕型長矛 hasta、gladius Hispaniensis 短劍、galea 頭盔與環鏈甲，工兵攜帶雲梯、撞柱、扭轉式投石機與攻城塔，輔助軍與騎兵負責巡邏與斷糧。運輸上，義軍以步行為主，用驢騾負重；羅馬靠墨西拿、卡塔基與利利拜三處港口把糧秣與援兵送上岸，再沿島內古道推進。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Spartan dory: a straight wooden shaft about two metres long, with a leaf-shaped head at the front and a bronze butt-cap at the rear, so that a warrior could plant it in the ground and kneel behind his shield; it was the standard spear of the Spartan and Greek city-state phalanx around 800 BC, more than eight hundred years before this war, and by 44 BC it had long ceased to be the standard arm of any army, the long-shafted weapons in use on European battlefields by then being the Macedonian sarissa and the Roman pilum. It is placed in this war in order to mark the source of that long-spear line of development in the Greek world. Messana, Tauromenium and Leontini in the east of Sicily were all ancient Hellenic cities, and their citizen militias still kept to the traditional kit of long spears, small round shields, bronze helmets and bronze breastplates, the construction of those spears being a direct inheritance from the type on the card; and in the Nebrodi and Madonie ranges, the slaves and peasants who herded, hunted and made charcoal carried long boar spears, sharpened oak poles and the long handles of farm tools, which are the same family surviving in the countryside. The equipment of the insurgents was therefore mixed: Roman short swords, bronze helmets and fragments of mail taken from the estates and the city armoury, the heavy shield and face-netting of a gladiator, Hellenic small round shields and bronze breastplates, slings and sling-stones, and a large number of roughly hewn pole weapons. Rome brought the full standard kit: the heavy pilum with the oval scutum, the light hasta, the gladius Hispaniensis, the galea and mail, while the engineers carried scaling ladders, battering rams, torsion stone-throwers and siege towers, the auxiliaries and cavalry handling patrols and the cutting of supplies. In movement the insurgents marched on foot and used donkeys and mules for burden; Rome landed grain and reinforcements at the harbours of Messana, Catagella and Lilybaeum and then pushed inland along the island's ancient roads.
tactics: 義軍的戰法以先破制高點、再守城待援為主軸。起事首先消滅的是莊園裡的守備、監工與武裝督工，奪取糧倉裡的穀物、油與酒，以及存放鐵器與盾牌的莊園武庫，然後帶著人與糧退入山地：恩泰拉這座建在山脊上的山城成了最堅固的依託，居高臨下，道路狹窄，牆體用石塊壘成，羅馬的攻城塔與撞柱難以施展。起義者善用游擊：熟悉山徑與牧道，敢於在狹窄地帶切割羅馬縱隊，襲擊糧車、燒掉驛站與橋樑，使島內的驛道網一段段失效；遇到羅馬列陣攻擊時則退入城牆與樹林，改以投槍與石彈消耗對方陣列，等其進入狹隘地形再以長矛與短兵衝擊。義軍還懂得政治宣傳：以宣告者的名義宣布解放、許諾土地與自由，藉此吸納城中的自由民與不滿的公民，並用繳獲的旗幟與銅牌打扮隊伍，模仿軍隊的樣子。羅馬的反制完全依循制度化的圍城術：先以使節試探，失敗後才改用軍事；海運補給線固定在墨西拿與卡塔基，軍隊在進攻方向上築壘設營，挖壕結柵，用工程兵造雲梯、填塞壕溝、架攻城塔，同時以騎兵巡邏切斷恩泰拉與鄉間糧源的聯繫，迫使守軍出城作戰；前43年安東尼接手後改為兩路同時施壓，攻取恩泰拉與托爾托拉，義軍首領相繼陣亡或被俘，剩餘隊伍在野地中被逐一解除武裝。
tacticsEn: The method of the insurgents turned on breaking the points of control first and then holding a city while waiting for the moment. The rising began by destroying the guards, the overseers and the armed drivers of the estates, seizing the grain, oil and wine in the storehouses together with the estate armouries where iron and shields were kept, and then withdrawing with men and provisions into the hills. Entella, a town built on a ridge, became their strongest support: it commands the ground below, the approaches are narrow, the wall is built of stone blocks, and the Roman siege towers and rams have little room to work. The insurgents were good at the skirmish: knowing the mountain paths and the cattle tracks, they dared to cut Roman columns in narrow places, to raid supply wagons and to burn down relay stations and bridges, so that the island's road net failed piece by piece. When the Romans came up in formation they withdrew behind walls and woods, switched to javelins and sling-stones to wear down the enemy line, and only charged with spear and short weapon once the fight was forced into a defile. They understood political propaganda too: announcing release in the name of the heralds, promising land and freedom, and thereby drawing in free inhabitants and discontented citizens of the towns, while dressing their bands in captured banners and bronze ornaments so that they would look like an army. The Roman counter followed the institutional art of siege: first a try at diplomacy through envoys, and only after that failure a switch to force. The sea supply line was fixed at Messana and Catagella, the army dug in and fortified on the axis of attack, engineers built scaling ladders, filled the ditches and raised siege towers, and cavalry patrols cut the link between Entella and the food of the countryside so as to force the garrison out to fight. In 43 BC, once Antony took over, the pressure was applied on two axes at once against Entella and Tortora; the rebel leaders were killed or taken one after another, and the remaining bands were disarmed piecemeal in the open country.
data: 關於這場戰爭，古代記載留下的數字有限，以下幾組最為可靠。時間跨度：前44年爆發，前43年被平定，前後約一年，是羅馬共和晚期最短的一次行省戰役。指揮序列：元老院使者三人赴西西里談判，於森圖里佩遇害，成為公開決裂的界線；羅馬方面先後有屋大維、馬爾凱羅斯、多米提烏斯·阿赫諾巴布斯與安東尼等四名指揮者介入，其中一人在米利切被自己人刺殺。義軍方面留下名字的領袖是兩人，據點則可確認有恩泰拉、托爾托拉、森圖里佩、米利切，以及東部的陶羅梅尼翁與列昂提尼。兵力方面，羅馬投入的是執政官級部隊，即兩支軍團加騎兵與援軍；單一羅馬軍團的步兵通常在四千五百至五千五百人之間，軍團騎兵約六百人，輔助軍與援軍另計。島嶼尺度：西西里南北長約二百四十公里，最寬處約一百公里；恩泰拉至墨西拿的直線距離約一百公里，至森圖里佩約九十公里，至帕諾爾莫斯約六十五公里。行政背景：西西里是羅馬第一個行省，前227年由元老院正式設立，島上主要城市逾二十座，其中東岸自梅格瑪拉到陶羅梅尼翁一段為希臘化城市，西部與西南部以拉丁殖民城市為主。義軍的總人數沒有留下可以核對的確切數字，古代作者只以成千上萬的模糊量級形容響應者。
dataEn: The ancient record preserves only a limited number of figures for this war, and the following groups are the most reliable. Duration: the rising broke out in 44 BC and was settled in 43 BC, about a year in all, which makes it the shortest provincial war of the late Roman Republic. Command sequence: three envoys of the senate went to Sicily to negotiate and were killed at Centuripe, which marks the line of open rupture; on the Roman side four commanders in turn intervened, among them Octavian, Marcellus, Gnaeus Domitius Ahenobarbus and Antony, and one of them was stabbed by his own men at Melite. On the insurgent side only two leaders are named, and the strongholds that can be confirmed are Entella, Tortora, Centuripe and Melite, together with Tauromenium and Leontini in the east. On strength: Rome committed forces of consular scale, that is, two legions with cavalry and reinforcements; a single Roman legion normally numbered between four thousand five hundred and five thousand five hundred foot, the legionary cavalry about six hundred, with auxiliaries and reinforcements counted apart. Island measurements: Sicily is about two hundred and forty kilometres long from north to south and about one hundred kilometres at its widest; the straight line from Entella to Messana is about one hundred kilometres, to Centuripe about ninety, and to Panormus about sixty-five. Administrative background: Sicily was Rome's first province, formally established by the senate in 227 BC, and the island had more than twenty main cities, the east coast from Megara to Tauromenium being Hellenic in character while the west and south-west were Latin colonial towns. No total that can be checked survives for the rebel numbers; the ancient writers describe the responders only in the vague order of thousands upon thousands.
cause: 起義的成因可以分三層。最底層是西西里的經濟結構：島上大片可耕地集中於少數大莊園，莊園、礦場與城市作坊依賴大量廉價勞動，奴隸的來源包括迦太基戰爭的戰俘、希臘世界的被販人口與本島的債務俘虜，勞動人口密度與莊園規模在羅馬行省中名列前茅。第二層是前135至前132年與前104至前100年兩次奴隸戰爭留下的餘波：島上仍有大量逃奴藏在山區與莊園之間，戰後的鎮壓並未根除這張網。第三層是公元前44年的政治環境：凱撒於三月遇刺，元老院與三頭同盟互相猜忌，執政官任期混亂，軍隊正在改編與重新募兵，島上的守軍既缺員又不知該聽誰的命令；同時奴隸的處境並未根本好轉，莊園主以高利貸、稅賦與鞭刑維持過度壓榨。東西兩側的城市各有算盤：希臘化城市的公民不願再被羅馬的總督與軍隊干涉，於是部分人倒向起義者；拉丁殖民城市與大地主則死守羅馬。觸發點是莊園裡的一次集體暴動與奴隸的奪械，接著元老院使者被殺，使運動再也無法用交涉收拾，戰爭由此全面展開。
causeEn: The causes of the revolt can be read on three levels. The lowest is the economic structure of Sicily: a great deal of the island's arable land had gathered into a few large estates, and the estates, the mines and the city workshops ran on a mass of cheap labour, the slaves coming from the prisoners of the Carthaginian wars, from the populations sold out of the Greek world and from debtors enslaved on the island, so that the density of the labour force and the scale of the estates placed Sicily near the top of the Roman provinces. The second level is the after-effect of the two slave wars of 135-132 BC and 104-100 BC: large numbers of runaways still hid in the mountains and between the estates, and the repression that followed had not rooted out that network. The third level is the political situation of 44 BC: Caesar had been killed in March, the senate and the Second Triumvirate suspected each other, the consulships were turned upside down, the armies were being reorganised and remanned, and the garrison on the island was short of men and did not know whose orders to obey. At the same time the condition of the slaves had not fundamentally improved, and the great owners kept the pressure on through usury, taxation and the lash. The cities on the two coasts each had their own calculation: the citizens of the Hellenic towns were unwilling to be interfered with any longer by the Roman governor and his soldiers, so some of them turned to the insurgents; the Latin colonial cities and the great landowners held fast to Rome. The trigger was a collective outbreak on the estates and the seizing of arms by the slaves; then the killing of the senatorial envoys made it impossible any longer to settle the movement by negotiation, and the war opened in full.
impact: 這場戰爭的意義首先在羅馬內戰的層面。前43年安東尼在西西里耗去了一年，等於讓屋大維得以在意大利重新編組軍隊；屋大維於同年九月在穆蒂納擊敗阿爾卑與安東尼的聯軍，安東尼此後被迫把重心移向東方，前42年的腓立比之戰則由這條戰線的落差直接引出。第二，西西里島的奴隸起義傳統並未因平定而中斷：前44年的叛軍雖然被解體，但逃奴、山區聚落與莊園內的暗線仍在，前73年第三次西西里奴隸戰爭重新爆發並席捲意大利中部，說明島上的火種一直沒有熄滅。第三，羅馬在島上的鎮壓模式再一次確立：以執政官級大軍加海運補給加工程兵圍城的三段式，取代前44年那種使者、將領、協防軍輪番上陣的混亂；此後西西里行省的常備兵與駐防安排都因此更趨固定。第四，在武器技術史的層面，這場戰爭提供了一個罕見的對照：公元前44年的西西里，同一座島上同時存在三種世代的長矛——卡面那種公元前800年近型的方陣長矛的殘存，即希臘城市的民兵與鄉村的獵矛、正在流行的羅馬標槍，以及更遠處的馬其頓式薩里沙；它說明武器的淘汰並不同步，傳統樣式往往以民俗與手工藝的形式在地方社會裡存活得比軍制更久。
impactEn: The meaning of this war lies first of all at the level of the Roman civil war. Antony spent a whole year in Sicily in 43 BC, which allowed Octavian to reorganise his army in Italy; in September of the same year Octavian defeated the allied force of Albinus and Antony at Mutina, and Antony was thereafter driven to shift his weight to the East, while the battle of Philippi in 42 BC grew directly out of the imbalance on this front. Second, the tradition of slave revolt in Sicily was not broken by the settlement: the insurgents of 44 BC were dispersed, but the runaways, the mountain settlements and the hidden threads inside the estates remained, and the third Sicilian slave war broke out again in 73 BC and swept through central Italy, showing that the spark on the island had never gone out. Third, the Roman model of suppression on the island was fixed once more: the three-part form of a consular-scale army plus sea-borne supply plus engineers at the walls replaced the confusion of 44 BC, in which envoys, generals and allied auxiliaries took turns at the front; the standing troops and the garrison arrangements of the Sicilian province were thereafter far more regular. Fourth, at the level of the history of weapon technology, this war offers a rare contrast: in 44 BC on one and the same island three generations of spear existed side by side — the survival of the phalanx spear of about 800 BC, that is the spears of the citizen militias of the Hellenic cities and the hunting spears of the countryside; the Roman pilum in current use; and further away the Macedonian sarissa. It shows that weapons do not fall out of use in step with one another: the old pattern often survives in local society, as folk practice and as hand craft, for far longer than it survives in the order of battle.
result: 前43年，馬克·安東尼接管西西里戰線，攻取恩泰拉與托爾托拉兩處山寨，叛軍的首領相繼陣亡或被俘，餘部在失去據點與糧食之後被解除武裝，一批人被發賣為奴，一批人逃入山區另尋出路。起義者所宣稱的解放並未兌現：西西里沒有得到自治，島上的莊園與稅制原封不動，奴籍人口被重新登記與監視，逃奴問題成為往後數十年行省治理的常態。羅馬付出的代價則是實實在在的：執政官級的機動力在島上運作了一整年，海運的糧秣與船隻、隨軍的工程器械與徵發的船員，數量遠超平叛所需；更關鍵的是時間成本，它讓安東尼未能及時回援意大利，阿爾卑的敗亡與屋大維的勝出都由此開始，羅馬共和國的最終崩解也沿著這條線索加速。
resultEn: In 43 BC Mark Antony took over the Sicilian front, took the two strongholds of Entella and Tortora, and the rebel leaders were killed or captured one after another; the remnant, deprived of its bases and its food, was disarmed, part of it was sold into slavery and part fled into the mountains to look for another way. The release the insurgents had proclaimed did not come about: Sicily received no autonomy, the estates and the tax system on the island were left exactly as they were, the registered slave population was put under fresh enumeration and surveillance, and the problem of the runaways became a standing feature of provincial government for the decades that followed. The price Rome paid was a real one: a consular-scale force was in operation on the island for a full year, and the grain, the ships, the engineers' gear and the impressed crews required by that were far more than the suppression needed. The cost in time mattered most: it kept Antony from returning to Italy in time to support Albinus, and both the defeat of Albinus and the victory of Octavian began there, so that the final collapse of the Roman Republic was hastened along this line.
